name: Codebaby Avatar
author: TELOS LABS

sections.description:
This plugin allows you to manage Codebaby Avatars, providing functionalities to integrate and control avatars easily within your WordPress site.

Third-Party Services

This plugin integrates with the Codebaby platform to provide avatar functionalities. When using this plugin, data such as avatar configurations and interactions may be sent to or retrieved from Codebaby’s servers. Please refer to Codebaby’s privacy policy and terms of service for more details on how your data is handled: Codebaby Privacy Policy and Terms of Service.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/codebaby-avatar directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Use the Settings->Codebaby screen to configure the avatars.
sections.faq:
How do I add an avatar?

  1. Add the Avatar from Codebaby settings or include it from shortcode on the page.
